王野吃完早饭就要去上班，可是当他出门的时候，看见王铁柱已经骑着自行车带着赵爷爷头里走了。王野懊悔地看着渐渐远去的两人，跟旁边的刘大山抱怨道：“刘叔，你说我爹是不是早就计划好了？”

“那还用说？我刚才出门的时候，就见你爹和你赵爷爷在悄悄地说话。”

王野也没办法，谁让那是他爹呢！要是别人敢不经他同意就骑走他的自行车，说什么也要让他尝尝全力的猛虎硬爬山。一路没精打采地走到工厂。

赵爷爷已经在门房里开始喝水了，王野看见赵爷爷喝的是白水，便问：“赵爷爷你怎么不喝茶水呀？我见他们都是喝茶水。”

赵爷爷没好气地回应：“屁的茶水！都是茶叶沫子，我才不喝那东西呢！还不如喝白开水。”

赵爷爷可是吃过喝过好东西的，对于茶叶沫子不感兴趣，也是事出有因。王野突然想起，自己空间里好像有两盒好茶叶，赶紧精神力进入空间查看，看着两盒龙井。

王野才想起这是当初在食品厂时，周主任送的。王野心想得抽空在空间里做点架子，东西多了得整理整理。

王野也没有立刻给赵爷爷，就让老头再喝一天白水吧。两人闲聊了一会儿，王野就回了办公室，今天王野是真的没事儿做了。无聊的只能趴在办公桌上假寐，可是现在的陈洛兮家可热闹了。

陈家今天不光儿子回家探亲，而且多年的战友也回四九城任职了，今天正好也来陈家做客。这时的陈家分成了三拨人在叙旧。

陈父陈近岳，跟刚回四九城的老战友秦伟在客厅里喝着茶正在叙旧。陈家大儿子陈少锋和秦家的大儿子秦自强，在院子里抽着烟闲聊。而陈洛兮在母亲李美娴的屋里陪着秦母韩雅文。

陈近岳和秦伟并没有聊工作的事儿，聊的都是家长里短，到了他们这个级别，一般不会在家里聊工作。聊着聊着就聊到了陈洛兮的婚事儿。

秦伟问：“老陈，你家洛兮也快到找对象的年龄了吧？要不是我家两个儿子年龄和你家洛兮不对，说什么我都得把你家洛兮娶到我家当儿媳妇。”

陈近岳无奈地回应：“别提了！现在这丫头大了，有自己的想法了。你嫂子给他相看了好几家的孩子，她都看不上。”

秦伟好奇地问：“那是不是这丫头在学校里有喜欢的人了？”

陈近岳满脸无奈：“学校里是没有，不过最近这丫头最近和一个叫王野的小子走的挺近。”

秦伟瞪大眼睛：“呦，这是有苗头呀！这叫王野的是谁家的孩子呀，我认识吗？”

陈近岳：“谁家的都不是，这不是前段时间，那丫头失足落水，被这个叫王野的救了，然后两人就有了联系了。连着两个周末了，这丫头总去找他。”

秦伟来了兴趣：“嚯，还是英雄救美呀！听你这意思，你还不满意，你不会还有门第之见吧？”

陈近岳没好气：“等你家小丫头到了找婆家的时候，你就知道了，看着所有的半大小子都是要拱自家小白菜的猪。”

秦伟微微一笑：“我就说嘛！以你老陈的能力也不会看不起老百姓家的孩子。”

陈近岳神神秘秘：“老秦，这个叫王野的孩子可不简单。”

这下秦伟可来了兴趣了，问：“你不是说不是谁家的孩子吗，连我都不认识的，应该也没什么人了吧？”

Wang Ye was going to work after breakfast, but when he went out, he saw that Wang Tiezhu had already taken Grandpa Zhao away on his bicycle.Wang Ye looked regretfully at the two people who were gradually going away, and complained to Liu Dashan next to him: "Uncle Liu, do you think my father had planned it a long time ago?"

"Does that need to be said? When I went out just now, I saw your father and your Grandpa Zhao talking quietly."

Wang Ye couldn't help it, who knew it was his father!If someone dared to ride his bicycle without his consent, he would have to try to climb the mountain with all his strength.We walked listlessly all the way to the factory.

Grandpa Zhao had already started drinking water in the concierge. Wang Ye saw that Grandpa Zhao was drinking plain water and asked, "Grandpa Zhao, why don't you drink tea? I see them all drinking tea."

Grandpa Zhao responded angrily: "That's shitty tea! It's all tea foam. I won't drink that stuff! It's better to drink boiled water."

Grandpa Zhao has eaten and drank good things, so he is not interested in tea foam, and there is a reason for it.Wang Ye suddenly remembered that there seemed to be two boxes of good tea in his space. He quickly entered the space to check and looked at the two boxes of Longjing tea.

Only then did Wang Ye remember that this was given by Director Zhou when he was at the food factory.Wang Zhiyi wanted to find some time to build some shelves in the space, and tidy up the many things.

Wang Ye didn't give it to Grandpa Zhao right away, so he just let the old man drink plain water for another day.The two chatted for a while, and then Wang Ye returned to the office. Wang Ye really had nothing to do today.He was so bored that he could only lie down on his desk and take a nap, but now Chen Luoxi's house is bustling.

Not only did the Chen family's son go home to visit relatives today, but his comrades for many years also returned to serve in Sijiu City, and they happened to be visiting the Chen family today.At this time, the Chen family was divided into three groups of people reminiscing about the past.

Chen's father, Chen Jinyue, and his old comrade Qin Wei, who had just returned to Sijiu City, were drinking tea in the living room and reminiscing about the past.Chen Shaofeng, the eldest son of the Chen family, and Qin Ziqiang, the eldest son of the Qin family, were smoking and chatting in the yard.Chen Luoxi was accompanying Qin's mother Han Yawen in her mother Li Meixian's room.

Chen Jinyue and Qin Wei didn't talk about work. They talked about their parents' feud. At their level, they generally wouldn't talk about work at home.While chatting, the subject of Chen Luoxi's marriage came up.

Qin Wei asked: "Old Chen, is your Luo Xi almost old enough to find a partner? If it weren't for the age difference between my two sons and your Luo Xi, I would have married your Luo Xi into my family as my daughter-in-law no matter what."

Chen Jinyue responded helplessly: "Don't mention it! Now this girl is older and has her own ideas. Your sister-in-law has shown him several children, but she doesn't like them."

Qin Wei asked curiously: "Does this girl have someone she likes in school?"

Chen Jinyue looked helpless: "There is no such thing in school, but recently this girl has been very close to a boy named Wang Ye."

Qin Wei's eyes widened: "Hey, this is a sign! Whose child is this Wang Ye? Do I know him?"

Chen Jinyue: "It doesn't belong to anyone. This is not the case some time ago. The girl fell into the water and was rescued by this man named Wang Ye. Then the two of them got in touch. For two weekends in a row, this girl always went to look for him."

Qin Wei became interested: "Hey, it's a hero who saves the beauty! What you mean is that you're not satisfied yet. Don't you still have a sense of family status?"

Chen Jinyue was not angry: "When your little girl comes to find her husband's family, you will know that all the half-year-olds are pigs who want to support their own little cabbage."

Qin Wei smiled slightly: "I'm just telling you! With your ability, Old Chen, you won't look down on the children of ordinary people."

Chen Jinyue was mysterious: "Old Qin, this child named Wang Ye is not simple."

Now Qin Weike became interested and asked: "Didn't you say that you are not someone's child? I don't even know him, so there shouldn't be anyone left, right?"
